scope.campaign: Qwen3.8 base OpenCode WebExploitBench v23 full collection

incident.finding: The attach-only client rebound sandbox_url on the terminal GET after release. TensorLake may change or clear that URL after termination, even though the exact sandbox id and name remain authoritative. The already accepted release was therefore left with write-ahead claims but without local RELEASED and FAILURE_COMPLETE receipts.

read_only_snapshot_metadata_diagnostic.diagnostic_boundary: The provider metadata API proves preserved snapshot identity and readiness but exposes no read-only filesystem-content endpoint. It cannot classify the causal collection runtime failure without a separately authorized model-free restore.

repair.post_release_rule: After the exact release request, allow only exact sandbox identity reconciliation. Require the same id and name plus terminal or absent provider state; do not rebind origin and reject every later remote-origin operation.
repair.offline_rule: A separately reviewed, self-digested exact terminal observation may complete only a failure-preservation receipt chain locally. Require the complete selected roster, all owner locks, all-row preflight, exact snapshot and release-claim bindings, absent provider credential, zero provider-client construction, and replay-safe claimed, RELEASED-only, or complete states.

causal_boundary.fresh_paid_launch_gate: Diagnose preserved filesystem state without reading benchmark content; land the causal runtime repair; pass a model-free qualification covering prompt rendering, writable target runtime overlays, cleanup, unmount, and immutable source stability; then use fresh campaign, sandbox, transaction, and output identities.
